We just released a Beyond Eden 1.1.2 version.

Finally, we thank the Russian translation team for the wonderful work!

notes.title: Now Available On Mac
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29187116/80646f7ac263cf81008b2a8f30f5fdec263e51f0.jpg

Hello everyone,

We're happy to announce the release of Beyond Eden for Mac!

Also, we just released Patch 1.01 - a small update that fixed problems with sound and typos.

    Fixed the problem that background music and ending theme play in the same time in Ending No.16.
    Fixed the problem that ending theme would not play when using the instrumental option.
    Fixed some typos.


If you find any typos or bugs, please let us know here.
It will help us improve the game. Thanks!

Hello everyone,

We're happy to announce the release of Beyond Eden for Mac!

Also, we just released Patch 1.0.1 - a small update that fixed problems with sound and typos.

    Fixed the problem that background music and ending theme play in the same time in Ending No.16.
    Fixed the problem that ending theme would not play when using the instrumental option.
    Fixed some typos.


If you find any typos or bugs, please let us know here.
It will help us improve the game. Thanks!
